clauses.clause: Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, you may have this enchantment become a 3/3 Sphinx creature with flying in addition to its other types until end of turn.
clauses.evidence: Partly in the trace: 'you cast an instant or sorcery (Crash Through) -> card's triggered ability [0] triggers', 'ask may: [fire, skip] -> fire', 'card: keywords +FLYING +TRAMPLE' (the trample comes from Crash Through's creatures-you-control grant, so it is a creature by then); 'you cast a creature (Staunch Shieldmate) -> none'. The 3/3, the opponent-spell case, the decline and the duration are not visible (the probe prints P/T only for printed creatures). Packs: riddleform_instant_animates_3_3_flier (your Shock + fire: power 3, toughness 3, FLYING, attacks for 3, opp 15) PASS; riddleform_decline_stays_enchantment (skip: no flying, cannot attack) PASS; riddleform_opponents_spell_does_not_trigger (opponent's Shock: no animation, cannot attack) PASS; riddleform_animation_ends_cannot_block_next_turn (after the turn ends: no flying, never offered a block, opp 2/2 connects) PASS. Tree is the canonical B2b-riddleform (CastSpellEvent FNot Creature, actor YOU; optional SET_PT 3/3 + GRANT_TYPE Creature Sphinx + FLYING, all DurationEot). The Sphinx subtype has no M21 reader, so it is not checked beyond the tree.
[activate [1] from battlefield]: 'you: mana U-1 W-2' (exactly {2}{U}), 'ask scry: [top, bottom]'; both the top and the bottom variants are played. Tree is the canonical B3-scry-n.
